actions: flexes, abducts, externally rotates hip; flexes knee -- the classic 'cross-legged tailor's-seat' combined action

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Longest muscle in the human body, crossing both the hip and knee diagonally; its very long parallel fascicles (essentially spanning its full length) are architecturally suited to large-excursion, low-force multi-joint motion rather than strength.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the middle third of the medial thigh. For injection, the proximal third and the distal third of the anteromedial thigh, matching the muscle's two arborization zones.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: The most superficial structure of the medial thigh, lying over vastus medialis and the adductors, which in turn lie on the femoral cortex.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Two injection sites follow directly from the two zones at 20-40% and 60-80%.
